description: Water heater sizing (tank and tankless) — Size a water heater. Tank: DOE peak-hour demand method gives the first-hour rating (FHR) needed and typical gas and electric tank sizes, from people (household size) or peak-hour uses (shower, bath, shave, hands, shampoo, dishes_hand, dishwasher, food_prep, laundry counts). Tankless: simultaneous flow GPM from tankless_shower, tankless_bath, tankless_kitchen, tankless_lav, tankless_dishwasher, tankless_laundry fixture counts, temperature rise from inlet_f (or zone 1-8 groundwater default) to setpoint_f (120), gas BTU/h (gas_eff 0.95) and number of 199k units, electric kW and 240 V amps with feasibility, max GPM a 199k gas or 27 kW electric unit can deliver. Offline estimate. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
